_readme: Publications shown on publications.html (see README.md). Add a paper with `python3 scripts/add_paper.py --doi <DOI>` (or --arxiv <id>), or copy an existing entry. Names in settings.highlight_names are shown in bold. 'thumb': a web-sized image in assets/papers/ named after the paper id (keep full-size originals in _source/paper-originals/). 'video': a YouTube or .mp4 link; the thumbnail then becomes a play button.

publications.title: SeekUI: Predicting Visual Search Behavior on Graphical User Interfaces with a Reward-Augmented Vision Language Model
publications.venue_type: ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
publications.description: A reward-augmented vision-language model that predicts visual search behavior on graphical user interfaces, bridging computational UI understanding with human attention modeling.

publications.title: Mind the Gap: Mapping Wearer–Bystander Privacy Tensions and Context-Adaptive Pathways for Camera Glasses
publications.venue_type: ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
publications.description: A multi-stakeholder study on wearer–bystander privacy tensions in camera glasses, through surveys (N=525) and paired interviews (N=20). Contributes a diagnostic framework for context-adaptive pathways for privacy protection.

publications.title: Human-AI-UI Interactions Across Modalities
publications.description: A workshop exploring how AI and multimodal interfaces can reshape human-computer interaction across text, voice, gesture, and extended reality. This is the fifth CHI workshop we have organized on computational user interfaces.

publications.title: VR Whispering: A Multisensory Approach for Private Conversations in Social Virtual Reality
publications.venue_type: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
publications.description: Whisper — a multisensory approach combining visual, auditory, and tactile cues to recreate the feel of whispering in social VR. A comparative evaluation (N=24) shows Whisper significantly outperforms existing methods in privacy, intimacy, and social presence.

publications.title: ILuvUI: Instruction-tuned LangUage-Vision Modeling of UIs from Machine Conversations
publications.venue_type: ACM Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces
publications.description: A vision-language model for UI understanding, instruction-tuned on machine-generated conversations about UI screenshots to support diverse downstream UI tasks.

publications.title: EyeFormer: Predicting Personalized Scanpaths with Transformer-Guided Reinforcement Learning
publications.venue_type: ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology

publications.title: Graph4GUI: Graph Neural Networks for Representing Graphical User Interfaces
publications.venue_type: ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems

publications.title: UEyes: Understanding Visual Saliency across User Interface Types
publications.venue_type: CM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
